rationale: Karsin brings deep expertise in database systems, distributed query optimization, and analytical SQL engines—exactly the kind of infrastructure knowledge that powers the data visualization and analytics dashboards Chetas builds. As a Principal Engineer at Oracle mentoring on database design, Karsin can help Chetas understand the data layer behind the tools he's developing, while Chetas's hands-on full-stack experience with Python and modern web frameworks offers a fresh perspective on how databases serve real-world applications.
intro_message: Karsin Kamakotti, meet Chetas Parekh — Karsin's expertise in analytical SQL engines and query optimization pairs perfectly with Chetas's work building data visualization and analytics dashboards, and Karsin is open to mentoring on database design challenges.
